title: A calm storybook game with a hand-painted feel
summary: A kid, a dog and a long way home: a gentle game that you play in your browser.

assets.excerpt: A frame at 1:45 of the post video

prompts.text: Make me a small playable storybook game that runs in the browser: a kid and a dog on a long way home through a few hand-painted scenes, calm and gentle, with no timers and no losing. Draw the pictures and make the sounds in code, build it in a new folder inside the current project folder, open it in my browser when it is ready, and ask me before you install anything.
